tips.text: Land Timewinder on a champion to slow them, then keep the return pass on them too. Aim so the device comes back through them for the second hit.
Use Phase Dive to line up a double hit with Timewinder or to get into position for Parallel Convergence.
Cast Parallel Convergence on a target's path, then walk into the sphere yourself. Entering it stuns enemies inside and gives you a shield.
Cast Parallel Convergence early when you set up a gank. The enemy sees the marker after a short delay, so cast it where they will run.
Trigger Z-Drive Resonance on an enemy champion before you leave a fight. It gives you a burst of speed to escape.
Chronobreak works as an escape or as a burst of damage. Use it to jump back to your afterimage and hit enemies around you while you heal.
Hit your attacks on a low-health enemy to finish them. Parallel Convergence adds damage to attacks against targets at low health.
Watch your Phase Dive attack when you are rooted, because you lose its bonus range.

combos.name: Phase Dive over walls
combos.when: When you want a quick escape or entry through jungle walls.
combos.text: Phase Dive gains extra range when aimed across a thin wall, so Ekko can dash through camp walls without a gap closer.

tips.text: Throw Timewinder through the enemy so it hits twice: once going out and again when it returns. Aim it at the champion, not the minions in front of them.
Use Phase Dive to line up a second hit from Timewinder or to get into range of Parallel Convergence.
Walk into your Parallel Convergence sphere once it forms to stun the enemy and gain a shield. Stay out of it and it only slows.
Place Parallel Convergence on where the enemy is walking. It takes a moment to form, so aim ahead of them.
Take risks to hit a champion with the third attack or spell. Z-Drive Resonance adds bonus damage and gives you speed to run away.
Chronobreak works as an escape, but it also deals damage when you rewind into enemies. Use it to finish a fight as well as to survive one.
Watch the afterimage that shows where Chronobreak will send you. Fight so that it lands you somewhere safe or on top of the enemy.
Hold Phase Dive when you can. Its dash is short, and the empowered attack teleports you to the target, so use it to close in or to reposition.

combos.name: Chronobreak stun trap
combos.when: When you are caught or low on health and a Parallel Convergence is placed between you and your afterimage.
combos.text: Chronobreak's dash passes through the link to your afterimage. If that path crosses the sphere, it detonates and stuns enemies, even while Ekko is untargetable.

combos.name: Stealth Chronobreak
combos.when: Once per match, right after learning Chronobreak at level 6.
combos.text: The afterimage appears the moment you learn Chronobreak. Using it straight away lets Ekko go back to his earlier spot without the enemy seeing a trail.

tips.text: Dodge Graves' End of the Line by moving sideways, and leave the trail it leaves behind before it blasts.
Hit Graves with Timewinder so he is slowed; the second hit as it returns hurts more.
Stay close to Graves with Phase Dive. His shotgun does the most damage up close, so keep him busy by forcing a trade.
Walk out of Smoke Screen quickly; leaving the cloud removes its slow and the vision loss.
Use Chronobreak to survive when Graves bursts you, then blast him as you rewind.
Stay out of the line between Jarvan and his Demacian Standard. Dragon Strike knocks you up if you stand in it.
Save Chronobreak for when Jarvan jumps on you with Cataclysm. It takes you out of the arena.
Use Timewinder to slow Jarvan when he tries to close in. Aim so it hits twice.
Fight Jarvan around Parallel Convergence. If he is stunned, you can win the trade.
Dodge Blade's Reach if you can. Without it, Kayn has a hard time reaching you with Umbral Trespass.
Hold Chronobreak for when Kayn jumps on you with Umbral Trespass. Rewinding gets you out and punishes him.
Watch for a warning on the wall edge near you. It means Kayn is in the terrain using Shadow Step.
Stun Kayn with Parallel Convergence while he is in a wall. Hard crowd control ends Shadow Step at once.
Damage Kayn while he is inside a wall. That shortens Shadow Step, so he cannot stay hidden.
Stay near minions, allies or a turret; Kha'Zix's Taste Their Fear loses its big bonus damage when you are not isolated.
Hold Chronobreak for when Kha'Zix jumps on you; the rewind heals you and damages him as you leave.
Place Parallel Convergence where Kha'Zix will land after Leap, and step in to stun him.
Hit Kha'Zix with Timewinder when he is out of Leap and Void Assault; he is vulnerable and slowed then.
Use Phase Dive to hop out of range when Kha'Zix vanishes from view, since his next attack will slow you.
Hit Kindred with Timewinder; she is fragile, and the slow field lets you follow up.
Use Phase Dive to close the gap and attack Kindred before she can slow you with Mounting Dread.
Step away from Kindred's third attack so Wolf's pounce from Mounting Dread doesn't land. Dodge it rather than trade into it.
Don't chase into Lamb's Respite; nobody inside can die, so wait for it to end.
Save Chronobreak for a fight with Kindred; she can pounce and kite you, and it is your escape.
Use Phase Dive to get on top of Lee Sin or to get away, and weave in an attack to blink onto him.
Save Chronobreak for when Lee Sin kicks or dives you; it pulls you back to safety and damages him.
Dodge Sonic Wave; without it Lee Sin has a hard time getting on you. Timewinder's slow helps you keep your distance.
Lure Lee Sin into Parallel Convergence and step in to detonate it; the stun gives you a free fight.
Lee Sin is weaker to magic damage, so trade with Timewinder and the Z-Drive Resonance bonus when he is low on Energy.
Master Yi ignores slows while Highlander is active, so save Timewinder's slow for when it is down.
Land Parallel Convergence and step into it to stun Master Yi. Stuns are what stop him while Highlander is on.
Keep Chronobreak ready for when Master Yi dives you. Rewinding takes you out of his reach and hits him as you arrive.
Master Yi vanishes during Alpha Strike, so don't waste Timewinder on him then. Hit him after he reappears.
Use Phase Dive to get away from Master Yi's chase, then place your other spells from a safe spot.
Use Chronobreak to escape or to win a fight when Naafiri dives you. Its blast and heal punish her if she commits.
Aim Timewinder at Naafiri when she closes in. The slow makes it hard for her to stay on you, and the return hit does extra damage.
Place Parallel Convergence where Naafiri is heading, then step into it. She is stunned and you get a shield.
Hit Naafiri with three attacks or spells in a row to trigger Z-Drive Resonance. The speed boost helps you chase her or get away.
Play around Nocturne's Shroud of Darkness: bait it with a cheap ability before you commit Parallel Convergence.
Stay near allies when Nocturne casts Paranoia. His dash cannot be stopped by crowd control, so do not fight alone.
Move away with Phase Dive when Nocturne uses Unspeakable Horror on you. Breaking the tether avoids the fear.
Keep Chronobreak ready for when Nocturne dashes in. Rewinding heals you and hits him.
Keep your distance from Shyvana and poke her with Timewinder. She is weak when she can't hit you.
Hit Shyvana while her Fury is low, before she can transform with Dragon's Descent.
Hold Chronobreak for when Shyvana dives you. Rewinding heals you and the blast hurts her.
Lure Shyvana into Parallel Convergence and step into it yourself to stun her and gain a shield.
Use Phase Dive to leave once Shyvana is on you, since her Molten Burst slows you.
Stun Skarner with Parallel Convergence before he reaches you. Ixtal's Impact ends if he is stunned.
When Skarner charges with Ixtal's Impact, stay away from walls. A wall hit stuns you.
Keep Chronobreak ready when Skarner is close. Impale can be dodged, so step out of its reach.
Use Timewinder to poke Skarner early, then fight on your terms. His sustained damage wins long trades.
Keep Chronobreak ready when Sylas is near. He can pull you in with Abduct, and rewinding lets you escape and hit him with the blast.
Chronobreak makes you immune to knock ups while it dashes, so use it to cancel Sylas's pull when he commits.
Fight Sylas when his Kingslayer healing is weak. Don't chase him once he is low, because the heal is strongest then.
Hit Sylas with Timewinder when he walks into a fight. The slow stops him from closing in or escaping.
Place Parallel Convergence where Sylas must stand to fight you, then step in to stun him. He can't dodge it once it is armed.
Ekko should keep Chronobreak ready when Talon is near. It answers his burst by rewinding you and healing.
Hit Talon with Timewinder when he flees. It leaves him slowed, so you can catch him.
Place Parallel Convergence where Talon will land or escape. Step into it to stun him and gain a shield.
Talon is much weaker without Shadow Assault. Pick fights after he has used it.
Stay out of Viego's Spectral Maw line. Keep a minion between you and him, since it stops at the first enemy it hits.
Use Phase Dive to get out of reach once Viego commits to a charge, then hit him with Timewinder.
Save Chronobreak for when Viego uses Heartbreaker or a fight turns against you. It heals you more the more health you lost.
Ward near where Viego's mist sits. He can hide there and ambush you.
Stay out of Xin Zhao's Audacious Charge range. It reaches farther against an enemy marked Challenged, and it slows you.
Place Parallel Convergence where Xin Zhao will walk, then step in to stun him. It can also shield you.
Dash away with Phase Dive before Xin Zhao lands his third Three Talon Strike attack, since it knocks you up.
Keep Chronobreak ready when Xin Zhao reaches level 6. Crescent Guard can burst you down, and rewinding gets you out.
Hit Xin Zhao with Timewinder from long range. He has no ranged attack, and the slow makes it hard for him to catch you.
Stay behind minions so Charm is hard to land; if Ahri hits you with it, you lose most of your trade.
Use Timewinder on Ahri to slow her, and try to hit her with the return too, as it does more damage.
Place Parallel Convergence where Ahri will end up after a trade, then step into it to stun her and gain a shield.
Ahri is much weaker without Spirit Rush, so push for a fight when she has used it.
Keep Chronobreak ready for when Ahri charms you; it can undo the damage and rewind you out of the fight.
Keep Chronobreak ready in fights against Akali. It lets you rewind away from her combo and hit her when you land.
Place Parallel Convergence where Akali will land or stand. If you step in, she is stunned and you get a shield.
Use Timewinder to slow Akali when she dives in; the field makes her harder to escape with.
Trade with Akali when she is low on energy, because Five Point Strike is weakest then.
Go back to base when you are low and Akali has Perfect Execution ready.
Aim Timewinder at Twilight Shroud, since area spells can hit her inside the smoke and briefly reveal her.
Dodge Flash Frost by sidestepping it. If it hits you, it slows you and your next Frostbite hurts a lot.
Do not stand at the end of Flash Frost's range. It stuns you when it bursts there.
Use Phase Dive to close the gap. Do it when Crystallize is on cooldown, since the wall can block your path.
Get three hits on Anivia with Z-Drive Resonance to gain speed. It helps you reach her or get away.
Killing Anivia is not enough. Her egg returns her to full health, so stay and finish the egg or fight elsewhere.
Watch for Aurora's Across the Veil; she turns invisible after the hop, so hold your Timewinder until she shows up again instead of throwing it blind.
Chronobreak can pull you out of Between Worlds or a bad fight. You are safe while it plays, so use it when Aurora commits her ultimate on you.
Trade when The Weirding is on cooldown; with no slow, Aurora struggles to stop Phase Dive from closing the gap.
Place Parallel Convergence where Aurora will stand when she fights, then step into it to stun her. Her hop backwards after The Weirding can leave her inside.
Dodge Noxious Blast by moving; it lands after a short delay. Don't stand in the poison, since Twin Fang hits harder on you.
Don't dive in with Phase Dive while Petrifying Gaze is ready and she faces you. Approach from the side or behind.
Turn away from her as Petrifying Gaze goes off, so you are slowed instead of stunned.
Hit her with Timewinder from long range; the slow field makes it harder for her to dodge your follow-up.
Miasma grounds you, so don't count on a dash to escape. Use Chronobreak to get out if she catches you.
Hold Timewinder for when Fizz uses Playful, then hit him as he lands; he cannot be hit while on his trident.
Stay away from Fizz while his Seastone Trident glows; his attacks hurt more for a few seconds.
Chronobreak can rewind you out of Chum the Waters' fish, so save it for that moment.
Make Fizz waste Playful first, then use Parallel Convergence and Phase Dive to trade while it is on cooldown.
Dodge Call of the Void by stepping out from between the two portals. Its silence shuts off all your abilities.
Don't stand near minions carrying Malefic Visions. When they die it spreads to you.
Hold Chronobreak for when Malzahar uses Nether Grasp on you. It can pull you out of the channel.
Hit Malzahar with Timewinder when his Void Shift is down, since it blocks most of the damage and crowd control while it's up.
Use Phase Dive to close in and burst Malzahar down. He is weak once you reach him.
Stay out of line with Command: Attack. Its Ball passes through everything in its path and hurts you again when it lands.
Hold Phase Dive until Orianna has used Command: Shockwave, or until the Ball is far from her. Her stun only reaches enemies near the Ball.
Throw Timewinder from long range when the Ball is far away. It slows her and hits her again when it returns to you.
Place Parallel Convergence where Orianna will be after she is slowed or cornered. Walk into it to stun her and gain a shield.
Keep Chronobreak ready for her level 6 all-in. It lets you escape the Shockwave stun, and the stun cannot stop you.
Stay away from Ryze when Spell Flux is on you; his Overload and Rune Prison then hit much harder.
Aim Timewinder so it hits Ryze on both passes. It slows him in the field, and the return deals extra damage.
Place Parallel Convergence where Ryze will be stuck, then step into it to stun him and gain a shield.
Keep Chronobreak for when Ryze commits his spells; it heals you and damages him.
Stun or otherwise interrupt Ryze while Realm Warp charges to cancel the portal.
Keep Chronobreak ready in the fight. Sylas can lock you down with Abduct, and rewinding gets you out and heals you.
Sylas heals with Kingslayer when he is low, so don't chase a low-health Sylas without enough damage to finish him.
Hit Sylas with Timewinder from long range. The return hit does extra damage, so line up shots where he can't easily step out of the field.
Place Parallel Convergence where Sylas will dash or fight. Walk into it to stun him and shield yourself.
Sylas can steal your ultimate with Hijack. Use Chronobreak when it matters, not just to bait him.
Poke with Timewinder and let the grenade come back for a second hit. Aim it so both passes land on Twisted Fate.
Dodge Wild Cards early, when you cannot afford to lose health. Stay out of its cone and away from his Gold Card.
When Twisted Fate uses Destiny, expect a gank and back away. His Destiny recast lets him teleport across the map.
Use Phase Dive to close in on Twisted Fate, then fight him before his Pick a Card is ready.
Do not stand inside Gravity Field for long; step out before it stuns you.
Use Phase Dive to close in on Viktor after he spends his Siphon Power, since he fights best at range.
Hit Viktor with both passes of Timewinder; the returning field also slows him.
Hold Chronobreak when Arcane Storm comes down, so you can rewind out of the damage.
Throw Timewinder at Yasuo to slow him. Hit him on the way out and again on the way back for full damage.
Do not throw Timewinder or Parallel Convergence into Wind Wall; the projectile is destroyed. Wait for it to end.
Stay away from Yasuo once he has two stacks of Steel Tempest. The next one fires a whirlwind that knocks you up.
Use Phase Dive to get out of Steel Tempest's narrow line. Moving sideways also dodges it.
Hold Chronobreak when Yasuo has a knock up ready, since an ally's knock up lets Yasuo use Last Breath too. Rewind out if he dives you.
Aim Timewinder so it hits Yone on the way out; the field slows him, and the returning device hits him again if he stays in it.
Parallel Convergence takes time to arm, so cast it where Yone will be after a dash, then walk in to stun him.
Hold Chronobreak for when Yone commits with Fate Sealed; it gets you out and damages him as you go.
Use Phase Dive to close in, then attack to land the third hit of Z-Drive Resonance and gain speed to leave.
Place Parallel Convergence where Zed will fight or escape, then step in to stun him. He can see it coming, so bait first.
Save Chronobreak for Zed's Death Mark. Rewinding out of it, or past it, wastes his combo.
Land Timewinder on Zed right after he uses Living Shadow. He has less mobility and damage then.
Stay out of range of Zed's shadow. Shadow Slash only slows you if a shadow hits you with it.
